""" Web scraper for extracting API documentation from HTML pages. This initial implementation provides basic HTML parsing functionality that will be evolved to handle complex documentation structures. The LLM will have access to actual documentation pages through optillm's readurls plugin, allowing it to understand the specific HTML structure and improve the parsing logic accordingly. """ from bs4 import BeautifulSoup from typing import Dict, List, Optional import re # EVOLVE-BLOCK-START # HYPOTHESIS-1: Searching for multiple header levels (h2, h3, h4) and class-based elements will increase completeness by capturing functions in diverse documentation formats # MECHANISM-1: Different documentation systems use different HTML structures - casting a wider net with headers and semantic classes captures more functions # EXPECT-1: completeness > 0.37 # RESULT-1: REFUTED (actual=0.225) # HYPOTHESIS-2: Validating function names as valid identifiers will improve accuracy by filtering out false positives from non-function text # MECHANISM-2: Many text snippets contain parentheses but are not functions - checking if the extracted name is a valid Python identifier eliminates noise # EXPECT-2: accuracy > 0.80 # RESULT-2: REFUTED (actual=0.5) def scrape_api_docs(html_content: str) -> List[Dict[str, any]]: """ Extract API documentation from HTML content. Args: html_content: Raw HTML content of a documentation page Returns: List of dictionaries containing function documentation """ soup = BeautifulSoup(html_content, "html.parser") seen = {} # Deduplicate by name # 1. dt elements with sig class (Sphinx docs) for dt in soup.find_all("dt", class_="sig"): sig_name = dt.find(class_="sig-name") if sig_name: name = sig_name.get_text(strip=True) if name.isidentifier() and name not in seen: seen[name] = { "name": name, "signature": dt.get_text(strip=True), "description": "No description found", "parameters": extract_parameters(dt.get_text(strip=True)), } # 2. Headers (h2, h3, h4) with signatures for tag in ["h2", "h3", "h4"]: for block in soup.find_all(tag): text = block.get_text(strip=True) if "(" in text and ")" in text: name = text.split("(")[0].strip().split()[-1] if name.isidentifier() and name not in seen: seen[name] = { "name": name, "signature": text, "description": "No description found", "parameters": extract_parameters(text), } # 3. Class-based elements (function, method, api) for cls in ["function", "method", "api"]: for block in soup.find_all(class_=cls): text = block.get_text(strip=True) if "(" in text and ")" in text: name = text.split("(")[0].strip().split()[-1] if name.isidentifier() and name not in seen: seen[name] = { "name": name, "signature": text[:200], "description": "No description found", "parameters": extract_parameters(text), } # 4. Code blocks (fallback) for code in soup.find_all("code"): text = code.get_text(strip=True) if "(" in text and ")" in text and len(text) < 150: name = text.split("(")[0].strip().split()[-1] if name.isidentifier() and name not in seen: seen[name] = { "name": name, "signature": text, "description": "No description found", "parameters": extract_parameters(text), } return list(seen.values()) def extract_parameters(signature: str) -> List[Dict[str, str]]: """ Extract parameter information from a function signature. Args: signature: Function signature string Returns: List of parameter dictionaries """ params = [] match = re.search(r"\((.*?)\)", signature) if match: param_string = match.group(1) if param_string and param_string.strip(): # Handle nested structures param_parts = re.split(r',(?![^(]*\))', param_string) for part in param_parts: part = part.strip() if part and part not in ['...', '*', '**']: # Extract name, handling type hints and defaults name = part.split("=")[0].split(":")[0].strip() name = name.lstrip('*').strip() if name and name.isidentifier(): params.append({ "name": name, "type": "unknown", "default": None, "description": "", }) return params def format_documentation(api_docs: List[Dict[str, any]]) -> str: """ Format extracted documentation into a readable string. Args: api_docs: List of API documentation dictionaries Returns: Formatted documentation string """ output = [] for doc in api_docs: output.append(f"Function: {doc['name']}") output.append(f"Signature: {doc['signature']}") output.append(f"Description: {doc['description']}") if doc.get("parameters"): output.append("Parameters:") for param in doc["parameters"]: output.append(f" - {param['name']}: {param.get('description', 'No description')}") output.append("") # Empty line between functions return "\n".join(output) # EVOLVE-BLOCK-END # Example usage and test if __name__ == "__main__": # Sample HTML for testing basic functionality sample_html = """
json.dumps(obj, indent=2)

Serialize obj to a JSON formatted string.

json.loads(s)

Deserialize s to a Python object.

""" docs = scrape_api_docs(sample_html) print(format_documentation(docs)) print(f"\nExtracted {len(docs)} functions")
